sentences.text: Sutradara teater itu sudah lama membina aktor-aktor muda dari kampung sekitar.
sentences.en: The theater director has long been nurturing young actors from the surrounding villages.
sentences.ko: 그 연극 연출가는 오래전부터 주변 마을의 젊은 배우들을 키워 왔어요.

sentences.text: Kondektur kereta itu senang membina anak-anak magang yang baru bekerja.
sentences.en: The train conductor enjoys mentoring the new trainees.
sentences.ko: 그 열차 차장은 새로 일하는 수습생들을 가르치는 걸 좋아해요.

sentences.text: Dalam adegan romantis itu, sang pangeran mencumbu putri dengan puisi dan bunga mawar.
sentences.en: In that romantic scene, the prince wooed the princess with poems and roses.
sentences.ko: 그 낭만적인 장면에서 왕자는 시와 장미로 공주에게 사랑을 속삭였어요.

sentences.text: Di gerbong sebelah, seorang pemuda mencumbu kekasihnya dengan rayuan sampai penumpang lain tersenyum.
sentences.en: In the next carriage, a young man sweet-talked his girlfriend until the other passengers smiled.
sentences.ko: 옆 칸에서 한 청년이 여자 친구에게 달콤한 말을 속삭여서 다른 승객들이 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Eko menjepit naskahnya dengan klip supaya halamannya tidak tercecer.
sentences.en: Eko clipped his script together so the pages wouldn't scatter.
sentences.ko: 에코는 대본 쪽이 흩어지지 않게 클립으로 집었어요.

sentences.text: Ayu menjepit tiketnya di sela buku agar tidak hilang.
sentences.en: Ayu tucked her ticket between the pages of her book so it wouldn't get lost.
sentences.ko: 아유는 표를 잃어버리지 않게 책 사이에 끼웠어요.

sentences.text: Setelah pertunjukan, Eko duduk sendirian di panggung sambil merenungkan perannya.
sentences.en: After the show, Eko sat alone on the stage reflecting on his role.
sentences.ko: 공연이 끝난 뒤 에코는 무대에 혼자 앉아 자기 배역을 곱씹었어요.

sentences.text: Sambil memandang sawah dari jendela, Ayu merenungkan keputusannya pindah kota.
sentences.en: Looking at the rice fields from the window, Ayu reflected on her decision to move cities.
sentences.ko: 창밖 논을 바라보며 아유는 이사하기로 한 결정을 곰곰이 생각했어요.

sentences.text: Drama malam ini bercerita tentang tuan tanah yang memperbudak para petani.
sentences.en: Tonight's play is about a landlord who enslaves the farmers.
sentences.ko: 오늘 밤 연극은 농민들을 노예처럼 부리는 지주 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Ayu membaca novel sejarah tentang kerajaan yang memperbudak penduduk pulau.
sentences.en: Ayu read a historical novel about a kingdom that enslaved the island's people.
sentences.ko: 아유는 섬 주민들을 노예로 삼은 왕국에 관한 역사 소설을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Lampu panggung dibuat redup untuk menggambarkan masa kelam dalam sejarah desa itu.
sentences.en: The stage lights were dimmed to portray a dark period in the village's history.
sentences.ko: 그 마을 역사의 어두운 시절을 나타내려고 무대 조명을 어둡게 했어요.

sentences.text: Langit tampak kelam ketika kereta memasuki daerah pegunungan.
sentences.en: The sky looked gloomy when the train entered the mountain area.
sentences.ko: 열차가 산간 지역에 들어서자 하늘이 어두워 보였어요.

sentences.text: Kursi kosong di barisan depan pada malam pembukaan adalah anomali bagi teater sepopuler itu.
sentences.en: Empty seats in the front row on opening night were an anomaly for such a popular theater.
sentences.ko: 개막일 밤 앞줄이 빈 것은 그렇게 인기 있는 극장으로선 이상한 일이었어요.

sentences.text: Kereta yang tiba tepat waktu hari itu terasa seperti anomali bagi Ayu.
sentences.en: The train arriving on time that day felt like an anomaly to Ayu.
sentences.ko: 그날 열차가 제시간에 도착한 게 아유에겐 이상한 일처럼 느껴졌어요.

sentences.text: Eko hanya membawa selembar kertas berisi catatan dialog ke ruang ganti.
sentences.en: Eko brought only a single sheet of paper with notes on his lines to the dressing room.
sentences.ko: 에코는 대사 메모가 적힌 종이 한 장만 분장실에 가져갔어요.

sentences.text: Ayu menulis surat untuk ibunya di atas selembar kertas tisu.
sentences.en: Ayu wrote a letter to her mother on a single sheet of tissue paper.
sentences.ko: 아유는 휴지 한 장에 엄마에게 보낼 편지를 썼어요.

sentences.text: Kritikus menulis bahwa sutradara baru itu memutilasi naskah klasik sampai kehilangan maknanya.
sentences.en: The critic wrote that the new director butchered the classic script until it lost its meaning.
sentences.ko: 평론가는 새 연출가가 고전 대본을 마구 잘라 내서 뜻을 잃게 했다고 썼어요.

sentences.text: Penumpang di depan Ayu membaca berita tentang polisi yang menangkap pelaku yang memutilasi korbannya.
sentences.en: The passenger in front of Ayu was reading news about police arresting a suspect who had dismembered his victim.
sentences.ko: 아유 앞자리 승객은 피해자를 토막 낸 범인을 경찰이 잡았다는 뉴스를 읽고 있었어요.

sentences.text: Dalam lakon itu, Eko berperan sebagai pedagang licik yang mengelabui raja.
sentences.en: In the play, Eko plays a cunning merchant who tricks the king.
sentences.ko: 그 연극에서 에코는 왕을 속이는 교활한 상인 역을 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Seorang calo mencoba mengelabui Ayu dengan menjual tiket palsu di stasiun.
sentences.en: A scalper tried to trick Ayu by selling her a fake ticket at the station.
sentences.ko: 한 암표상이 역에서 가짜 표를 팔아 아유를 속이려 했어요.

sentences.text: Suasana haru tercipta ketika seluruh pemain menyanyi bersama di akhir pertunjukan.
sentences.en: A moving atmosphere was created when all the actors sang together at the end of the show.
sentences.ko: 공연 마지막에 배우들이 다 함께 노래하자 뭉클한 분위기가 생겼어요.

sentences.text: Persahabatan Ayu dengan nenek di kursi sebelah tercipta hanya dalam satu perjalanan.
sentences.en: Ayu's friendship with the grandmother in the next seat was formed in just one trip.
sentences.ko: 아유와 옆자리 할머니의 우정은 단 한 번의 여행에서 생겼어요.

sentences.text: Bagi Eko, tepuk tangan penonton adalah hadiah yang tak ternilai.
sentences.en: For Eko, the audience's applause is a priceless gift.
sentences.ko: 에코에게 관객의 박수는 값을 매길 수 없는 선물이에요.

sentences.text: Pemandangan matahari terbit dari jendela kereta itu tak ternilai bagi Ayu.
sentences.en: The view of the sunrise from the train window was priceless to Ayu.
sentences.ko: 열차 창밖으로 본 해돋이는 아유에게 무엇과도 바꿀 수 없었어요.

sentences.text: Eko harus berwajah garang selama dua babak sebagai prajurit penjaga gerbang.
sentences.en: Eko has to wear a fierce face for two acts as a soldier guarding the gate.
sentences.ko: 에코는 성문을 지키는 병사로 두 막 내내 사나운 얼굴을 해야 해요.

sentences.text: Petugas restorasi yang berwajah ramah menawarkan teh hangat kepada Ayu.
sentences.en: The dining-car attendant with a friendly face offered Ayu some warm tea.
sentences.ko: 다정한 얼굴의 식당칸 승무원이 아유에게 따뜻한 차를 권했어요.

sentences.text: Tiket yang habis dalam sehari menjadi indikasi bahwa pentas itu akan sukses.
sentences.en: Tickets selling out in a day were an indication that the show would be a success.
sentences.ko: 표가 하루 만에 매진된 것은 그 공연이 성공할 거라는 신호였어요.

sentences.text: Getaran aneh di gerbong bisa menjadi indikasi ada masalah pada rel.
sentences.en: Strange shaking in the carriage can be an indication of a problem with the tracks.
sentences.ko: 객차가 이상하게 흔들리는 건 선로에 문제가 있다는 신호일 수 있어요.

sentences.text: Petugas panggung meratakan pasir di lantai sebelum adegan gurun dimulai.
sentences.en: The stagehand leveled the sand on the floor before the desert scene began.
sentences.ko: 무대 담당은 사막 장면이 시작되기 전에 바닥의 모래를 고르게 폈어요.

sentences.text: Dari jendela, Ayu melihat alat berat yang sedang meratakan tanah untuk jalur baru.
sentences.en: From the window, Ayu saw heavy machinery leveling the ground for a new line.
sentences.ko: 아유는 창밖으로 새 노선을 위해 땅을 고르는 중장비를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Jumlah penonton teater itu sempat menyusut ketika harga tiket naik.
sentences.en: The theater's audience numbers shrank for a while when ticket prices went up.
sentences.ko: 표값이 오르자 그 극장 관객 수가 한동안 줄었어요.

sentences.text: Air di sungai yang dilewati kereta sudah menyusut karena kemarau panjang.
sentences.en: The water in the river the train passed had shrunk because of the long dry season.
sentences.ko: 긴 가뭄 때문에 열차가 지나는 강의 물이 줄어 있었어요.

sentences.text: Sejak video latihannya tersebar di internet, popularitas Eko naik dengan cepat.
sentences.en: Since his rehearsal video spread on the internet, Eko's popularity has risen quickly.
sentences.ko: 연습 영상이 인터넷에 퍼진 뒤로 에코의 인기가 빠르게 올랐어요.

sentences.text: Kata kondektur, popularitas kereta malam meningkat sejak harga tiket pesawat naik.
sentences.en: According to the conductor, the popularity of night trains has risen since airfares went up.
sentences.ko: 차장 말로는 비행기표 값이 오른 뒤로 야간열차의 인기가 높아졌대요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama fiksi ilmiah itu, para ilmuwan berlomba menghentikan senjata pemusnah dari luar angkasa.
sentences.en: In that science-fiction play, the scientists race to stop a weapon of destruction from outer space.
sentences.ko: 그 공상 과학 연극에서 과학자들은 우주에서 온 파괴 무기를 막으려고 서둘러요.

sentences.text: Di stasiun, Ayu melihat poster film tentang senjata pemusnah massal.
sentences.en: At the station, Ayu saw a poster for a film about weapons of mass destruction.
sentences.ko: 아유는 역에서 대량 살상 무기에 관한 영화 포스터를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Sebelum pertunjukan, pengeras suara meminta penonton mematikan ponsel.
sentences.en: Before the show, the loudspeaker asked the audience to turn off their phones.
sentences.ko: 공연 전에 확성기로 관객에게 휴대폰을 꺼 달라고 안내했어요.

sentences.text: Suara dari pengeras suara mengumumkan bahwa kereta akan tiba di stasiun berikutnya.
sentences.en: The voice from the loudspeaker announced that the train would arrive at the next station.
sentences.ko: 확성기에서 다음 역에 곧 도착한다는 안내 방송이 나왔어요.

sentences.text: Lakon detektif itu mengikuti polisi yang membongkar sindikat pencuri lukisan.
sentences.en: The detective play follows a police officer who breaks up a painting theft syndicate.
sentences.ko: 그 탐정 연극은 그림 도둑 조직을 소탕하는 경찰을 따라가요.

sentences.text: Polisi kereta api berhasil menangkap anggota sindikat pencopet di gerbong ekonomi.
sentences.en: The railway police managed to catch members of a pickpocket syndicate in the economy carriage.
sentences.ko: 철도 경찰이 일반실에서 소매치기 조직원들을 붙잡았어요.

sentences.text: Naskah lama itu mengkritik pelacuran anak di kota pelabuhan pada masa kolonial.
sentences.en: That old script criticizes child prostitution in port cities during the colonial era.
sentences.ko: 그 옛 대본은 식민지 시대 항구 도시의 아동 성매매를 비판해요.

sentences.text: Ayu mendengar siaran radio tentang upaya pemerintah memberantas pelacuran di kota besar.
sentences.en: Ayu heard a radio broadcast about the government's efforts to stamp out prostitution in big cities.
sentences.ko: 아유는 대도시 성매매를 뿌리 뽑으려는 정부 노력에 관한 라디오 방송을 들었어요.

sentences.text: Tokoh yang diperankan Eko adalah penganut ajaran lama yang menolak perubahan.
sentences.en: The character Eko plays is a follower of old teachings who rejects change.
sentences.ko: 에코가 맡은 인물은 변화를 거부하는 옛 가르침의 신봉자예요.

sentences.text: Di kursi sebelah, seorang penganut agama Buddha membaca buku doa dengan tenang.
sentences.en: In the next seat, a follower of Buddhism quietly read a prayer book.
sentences.ko: 옆자리에서 한 불교 신자가 조용히 기도서를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Di belakang panggung beredar desas-desus bahwa pemeran utama akan pindah ke film.
sentences.en: Rumors went around backstage that the lead actor would move to film.
sentences.ko: 무대 뒤에서는 주연 배우가 영화로 옮긴다는 소문이 돌았어요.

sentences.text: Para penumpang membicarakan desas-desus tentang kenaikan harga tiket kereta.
sentences.en: The passengers talked about rumors of a train fare increase.
sentences.ko: 승객들은 기차표 값이 오른다는 소문을 이야기했어요.

sentences.text: Kakek Eko yang baru pulang haji datang menonton dengan mengenakan peci putih.
sentences.en: Eko's grandfather, just back from the hajj, came to watch wearing a white cap.
sentences.ko: 막 성지 순례에서 돌아온 에코의 할아버지가 흰 모자를 쓰고 공연을 보러 왔어요.

sentences.text: Ayu duduk di samping rombongan jemaah haji yang akan menuju bandara.
sentences.en: Ayu sat next to a group of hajj pilgrims heading to the airport.
sentences.ko: 아유는 공항으로 가는 성지 순례단 옆에 앉았어요.

sentences.text: Adegan rapat majelis kerajaan dibuat panjang agar penonton merasakan ketegangannya.
sentences.en: The royal council meeting scene was made long so the audience would feel the tension.
sentences.ko: 왕실 회의 장면은 관객이 긴장감을 느끼도록 길게 만들었어요.

sentences.text: Ayu membaca berita tentang sidang majelis yang membahas tarif angkutan umum.
sentences.en: Ayu read news about an assembly session discussing public transport fares.
sentences.ko: 아유는 대중교통 요금을 논의하는 의회 회의 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Eko ikut drama ini atas kemauannya sendiri, bukan karena paksaan orang tua.
sentences.en: Eko joined this play of his own free will, not because his parents forced him.
sentences.ko: 에코는 부모님의 강요가 아니라 스스로 원해서 이 연극에 참여했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu memilih naik kereta tanpa paksaan siapa pun, karena ia memang suka perjalanan panjang.
sentences.en: Ayu chose to take the train without anyone forcing her, because she really likes long journeys.
sentences.ko: 아유는 누가 시켜서가 아니라 긴 여행을 좋아해서 기차를 골랐어요.

sentences.text: Babak kedua menggambarkan pemusnahan kampung oleh pasukan penjajah.
sentences.en: The second act depicts the destruction of a village by colonial troops.
sentences.ko: 이막은 침략군이 마을을 없애 버리는 장면을 그려요.

sentences.text: Kereta melewati pabrik tempat pemusnahan barang selundupan dilakukan setiap tahun.
sentences.en: The train passed the factory where smuggled goods are destroyed every year.
sentences.ko: 열차는 해마다 밀수품을 폐기하는 공장 옆을 지나갔어요.

sentences.text: Latar belakang panggung dilukis di atas kanvas raksasa oleh siswa sekolah seni.
sentences.en: The stage backdrop was painted on a giant canvas by art school students.
sentences.ko: 무대 배경은 미술학교 학생들이 거대한 캔버스에 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Seorang pelukis di gerbong sebelah menggambar pemandangan di atas kanvas kecil.
sentences.en: A painter in the next carriage drew the scenery on a small canvas.
sentences.ko: 옆 칸의 한 화가가 작은 캔버스에 풍경을 그렸어요.

sentences.text: Dalam drama politik itu, Eko memerankan tokoh oposisi yang selalu membantah perdana menteri.
sentences.en: In the political drama, Eko plays an opposition figure who always argues against the prime minister.
sentences.ko: 그 정치극에서 에코는 늘 총리에게 반박하는 야당 인물을 연기해요.

sentences.text: Dua penumpang berdebat seru tentang partai oposisi yang baru menang pemilu.
sentences.en: Two passengers argued heatedly about the opposition party that had just won the election.
sentences.ko: 두 승객이 막 선거에서 이긴 야당을 두고 열띤 논쟁을 벌였어요.

sentences.text: Teater kecil itu bertahan berkat donasi dari para penonton setia.
sentences.en: The small theater survives thanks to donations from loyal audience members.
sentences.ko: 그 작은 극장은 충실한 관객들의 기부 덕분에 버티고 있어요.

sentences.text: Stasiun itu menyediakan kotak donasi untuk korban banjir.
sentences.en: The station provides a donation box for flood victims.
sentences.ko: 그 역에는 홍수 피해자를 위한 기부함이 있어요.

sentences.text: Dalam lakon sejarah itu, raja kecil harus mengirim upeti berupa emas ke kerajaan besar.
sentences.en: In the historical play, the minor king must send tribute in gold to the great kingdom.
sentences.ko: 그 사극에서 작은 왕은 큰 왕국에 금으로 조공을 바쳐야 해요.

sentences.text: Pemandu wisata di kereta bercerita tentang upeti yang dulu dibawa lewat jalur ini.
sentences.en: The tour guide on the train told about the tribute that used to be carried along this route.
sentences.ko: 열차 안 관광 안내원이 옛날 이 길로 실어 나르던 조공 이야기를 해 줬어요.

sentences.text: Aktris terkenal itu datang ke teater dengan pengawalan ketat.
sentences.en: The famous actress came to the theater under tight escort.
sentences.ko: 그 유명 여배우는 삼엄한 경호를 받으며 극장에 왔어요.

sentences.text: Seorang menteri naik kereta yang sama dengan Ayu tanpa pengawalan berlebihan.
sentences.en: A minister rode the same train as Ayu without an excessive escort.
sentences.ko: 한 장관이 요란한 경호 없이 아유와 같은 열차를 탔어요.

sentences.text: Penulis naskah membuat amandemen kecil pada dialog setelah latihan pertama.
sentences.en: The scriptwriter made a small amendment to the dialogue after the first rehearsal.
sentences.ko: 극작가는 첫 연습 뒤 대사를 조금 고쳤어요.

sentences.text: Ayu membaca artikel tentang amandemen aturan bagasi di kereta jarak jauh.
sentences.en: Ayu read an article about an amendment to the luggage rules on long-distance trains.
sentences.ko: 아유는 장거리 열차 짐 규정 개정에 관한 기사를 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Drama itu diangkat dari berita penganiayaan pekerja rumah tangga yang menghebohkan kota.
sentences.en: The play was adapted from a news story about the abuse of a domestic worker that shocked the city.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 도시를 떠들썩하게 한 가사 노동자 학대 기사를 바탕으로 했어요.

sentences.text: Berita di layar kereta melaporkan kasus penganiayaan hewan yang sedang diselidiki polisi.
sentences.en: The news on the train screen reported an animal abuse case being investigated by police.
sentences.ko: 열차 화면 뉴스에서 경찰이 조사 중인 동물 학대 사건을 보도했어요.

sentences.text: Tim properti mengecat selongsong peluru palsu agar terlihat seperti kuningan.
sentences.en: The props team painted fake bullet casings so they would look like brass.
sentences.ko: 소품 팀은 가짜 탄피를 놋쇠처럼 보이게 칠했어요.

sentences.text: Di museum stasiun, Ayu melihat selongsong peluru dari masa perjuangan.
sentences.en: In the station museum, Ayu saw bullet casings from the independence struggle.
sentences.ko: 아유는 역 박물관에서 독립 투쟁 시절의 탄피를 봤어요.

sentences.text: Lakon itu menyindir rezim yang melarang rakyat bernyanyi di jalan.
sentences.en: The play satirizes a regime that bans people from singing in the streets.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 사람들이 거리에서 노래하는 것을 금지한 정권을 풍자해요.

sentences.text: Nenek di sebelah Ayu bercerita tentang hidupnya di bawah rezim lama.
sentences.en: The grandmother next to Ayu talked about her life under the old regime.
sentences.ko: 아유 옆 할머니는 옛 정권 아래에서 살던 이야기를 해 줬어요.

sentences.text: Setiap aktor baru menerima buku pedoman tentang aturan di belakang panggung.
sentences.en: Every new actor receives a guidebook on backstage rules.
sentences.ko: 새 배우는 모두 무대 뒤 규칙을 담은 지침서를 받아요.

sentences.text: Ayu membaca pedoman keselamatan yang ditempel di dinding gerbong.
sentences.en: Ayu read the safety guidelines posted on the carriage wall.
sentences.ko: 아유는 객차 벽에 붙은 안전 수칙을 읽었어요.

sentences.text: Eko mengeluh karena izin pentas tertunda oleh birokrasi yang berbelit-belit.
sentences.en: Eko complained because the performance permit was delayed by convoluted bureaucracy.
sentences.ko: 에코는 복잡한 관료 절차 때문에 공연 허가가 늦어져서 불평했어요.

sentences.text: Ayu kesal karena harus melewati birokrasi panjang hanya untuk mengembalikan tiket.
sentences.en: Ayu was annoyed at having to go through long bureaucracy just to return a ticket.
sentences.ko: 아유는 표 하나 환불하는 데도 긴 관료 절차를 거쳐야 해서 짜증이 났어요.

sentences.text: Asap dupa memenuhi panggung dalam adegan upacara di candi.
sentences.en: Incense smoke filled the stage in the temple ceremony scene.
sentences.ko: 사원 의식 장면에서 향 연기가 무대를 가득 채웠어요.

sentences.text: Dari jendela, Ayu mencium wangi dupa dari pura di dekat rel.
sentences.en: From the window, Ayu smelled incense from a temple near the tracks.
sentences.ko: 아유는 창문으로 선로 근처 사원에서 나는 향 냄새를 맡았어요.

sentences.text: Drama itu menunjukkan betapa sulitnya penegakan hukum di desa terpencil.
sentences.en: The play shows how hard law enforcement is in a remote village.
sentences.ko: 그 연극은 외딴 마을에서 법을 집행하기가 얼마나 어려운지 보여 줘요.

sentences.text: Petugas stasiun meningkatkan penegakan aturan dilarang merokok di peron.
sentences.en: Station staff stepped up enforcement of the no-smoking rule on the platform.
sentences.ko: 역무원들은 승강장 금연 규칙 단속을 강화했어요.
